violations.text: Ice and an ice scoop were observed in both hand-washing sinks at the bar. Hand-washing sinks must be used for hand washing only and may not be used for any other purpose. The ice was voluntarily discarded at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2026

The chlorine concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). The concentration of chlorine in the sanitizing solution must be between 50-100 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2026

At the time of inspection, ice intended for drinks was observed stored in the three-bay sink and hand-washing sinks at the bar. PIC was informed that ice used for drinks may not be stored in hand-washing sinks or the three-bay sink due to contamination risks. See voluntary disposal. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine in the kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2025
The hand-washing sink in the bar was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2025

The popcorn scoop is stored on an unclean surface (popcorn table) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2025

The walls in the mop sink area are constructed of sheetrock. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 12/13/2025

The dumpster outside is located on gravel. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2024
